title: Private-Safe Image Editing and Deterministic Transformation Routing
summary: KESPA v7.0 introduced a first-class privacy-aware image_edit capability after the system correctly failed closed when no provider was authorized to receive private image data. The implementation explicitly authorized the local image bridge, added deterministic transparent-background processing, provider fallback strategies, stronger edit lineage/provenance, and safer user-facing error handling, all through the Admin/brain_config/provider-routing control plane without requiring a Brain runtime modification. Production validation remained pending in the supplied source.
